store_description: Welcome to our shop! This shop started quite simply: with a messy sketchbook, an over-caffeinated brain, and a deep love for the kind of quick-witted, nerdy humor that makes you snort-laugh into your morning brew. Every single design starts as a doodle or hand-inked sketch and is printed to order on cozy, durable shirts and sturdy ceramic mugs.

mugs.title: Schrödinger’s Cat
mugs.subtitle: Wanted: Dead & Alive
mugs.description: For those mornings when you’re feeling a bit of both, this "Schrödinger’s Cat" mug features my original, hand-drawn illustration of physics’ most famous—and famously undecided—feline. I loved bringing this nerdy paradox to life with a detailed, split-character sketch that gently blends an adorable kitty with a skeletal side. It’s printed on a sturdy, cozy ceramic mug that is both microwave and dishwasher safe, ready to hold your favorite morning brew. A perfect, quirky gift for science geeks, cat lovers, or deep thinkers, it’s sure to add a little existential humor to any desk. Because each one is printed to order just for you, your mug gets made with plenty of care the moment you purchase.

mugs.title: Don't Trust Atoms
mugs.subtitle: They Make Up Everything
mugs.description: Delicate Bohr-inspired orbital rings, nucleus cluster, and sine wave harmonics rendered in crisp minimalist line art on a white 11oz ceramic mug.

mugs.title: Watt Is Love
mugs.subtitle: Baby Don't Hertz Me
mugs.description: Fine-line filament bulb with heart-shaped glowing wire, orbital electron paths, and frequency wave accents.

mugs.title: I Have Potential
mugs.subtitle: Energy
mugs.description: A sphere poised at the crest of a steep incline overlaid with dashed trajectory curves, harmonic waves, and subtle celestial coordinates.

mugs.title: May The Force
mugs.subtitle: Be Mass Times Acceleration
mugs.description: Newton's falling apple encircled by planetary orbits, gravitational field lines, and minimalist star accents.

mugs.title: Entropy
mugs.subtitle: It Is Not What It Used To Be
mugs.description: Fine-line hourglass with flowing sand, intersecting wave functions, and dispersing orbital particles.
